allOf.description:
High-level functional state of a customer.

* `Enabled` — customer is active: can subscribe, access the portal, manage subscriptions, and download invoices
* `Suspended` — customer is suspended: portal and hosted pages are inaccessible
allOf.title: StatusCustomer

Status.description: Functional customer status. Derived from `StateCustomer` — set `StateCustomer`, not `Status`.

StateCustomer.description:
Granular technical state of a customer.

* `Enabled` — customer is active (`Status` = `Enabled`)
* `Suspended` — customer has been suspended (`Status` = `Suspended`)
StateCustomer.title: StateCustomer
